subtasks.description: Declare all registers (offset, we, din, wr_tx, reset_tx_fifo, first, ackd, delay) and any necessary combinational wires, ensuring port/interface fidelity as per S004 and S005.
constraints: Port declarations must exactly match the interface specified in S004.

subtasks.description: Instantiate sd_tx_fifo with ports connected as per S007: d(din), wr(wr_tx), wclk(clk), q(dat_o), rd(rd), full(fe), empty(empty), mem_empt(...), rclk(sd_clk), rst(reset_tx_fifo or combined reset).
Combinational assignment of m_wb_adr_o = adr + offset, m_wb_we_o = 1'b0, m_wb_cti_o = 3'b000, m_wb_bte_o = 2'b00, as per S004 interface constants.

Sequential block (clk, async reset rst) implementing: start condition, Wishbone handshake (m_wb_cyc_o, m_wb_stb_o), ack capture, wr_tx control, delay/ackd flag updates, offset increment, disable/reset behavior, as described in S009, S010, S011.
constraints: Implement as flag-driven logic with toggle flags ackd and delay; use a single always block sensitive to posedge clk or negedge rst.
All registered outputs must use non-blocking assignments (<=).

subtasks.description: Continuous assignments: assign dat_o = sd_tx_fifo_q; assign empty = sd_tx_fifo_empty; assign fe = sd_tx_fifo_full; matching S004 port spec and S007 FIFO outputs.
